decisions.statement: A model check is gathered beside the code checks rather than by a runner of its own.
A count of runs above no runs is the phase a check runs on.
A statement in the body before the change is passed over.
A page whose definition the change alters has every statement judged again.
The call is spawned rather than awaited.
A check answers before a promise would settle.
A model reached by no call leaves the change unjudged rather than refusing that change.
An answer that cannot be read is a model reached by no call.
An answer opening with yes is a refusal.
A statement answered yes is asked no further.
A root naming no model check is answered with no model checks rather than refused.
Nothing here says why a statement is bad.
A check counting runs for both phases spends its change count at audit.
A check that did not run says so on standard error alone.

definition: the model checks the index names, gathered so a runner can run them
